department: Department of Mathematics, Applied Mathematics and Statistics

deadline.value: The priority deadline for the PhD is January 5, 2027. The final MS and PhD deadline is May 10, 2027.

gre_subject.value: Neither the university nor the department requires the GRE Subject test.
gre_subject.quote: Neither the university, nor the department requires taking the GRE Subject test.

supervisor.value: The admission pages give no rule on a supervisor's agreement before admission.

funding.value: Assistantships include tuition and a stipend, but support goes to only a select number of PhD students.
funding.quote: support is only available to a select number PhD students

also.quote: All assistantship awards include tuition and stipend to cover basic living expenses.

entry_route.value: Any accredited bachelor's holder can apply. Students with a relevant master's need 18 hours of approved courses instead of 36.
entry_route.quote: The holder of a bachelor’s degree from any accredited college or university is eligible for consideration for admission to our graduate program.

also.quote: For students entering with a Master’s degree in a mathematical subject compatible with our program, as determined by the graduate committee, this requirement is reduced to 18 credit hours of approved courses.

gre_general.value: The GRE General is optional but preferred.
gre_general.quote: Graduate Record Examination (GRE) scores are optional but preferred

notes: The PhD fee is $85 (FAQ), the same as the School rule, so it is inherited. Fee waivers are limited and first-come, first-served (FAQ). The department's FAQ gives TOEFL 5.0 or 90, the same as the School rule. Applied Mathematics PhD (https://mathstats.case.edu/phd/applied/) is in the same department and was not separately researched.
name: Mathematics PhD
